summary: This plugin provides client-side boot-time fault handling for DeepSeek Harness Web by notifying users of plugin load failures and allowing problematic plugins to be blacklisted so page loading can continue.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is a Web UI resilience utility for DeepSeek Harness that focuses on client-side bootstrap stability: it hooks the module loader to skip crashing/malformed plugins, reports missing plugin bundles, and offers localStorage-based plugin blocking and reset controls, with stated no-server/no-disk-write behavior. Its primary purpose is user-facing load-time protection and operational feedback rather than plugin creation, data processing, external integrations, or collaboration.
